<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Batch-API -->

# Batch API

Batch processing runs many `generateContent` (or embedding) requests asynchronously at a lower price than
interactive calls. You submit a job, poll it (or get a webhook), and read the results when it finishes.

`BatchClient` (namespace `GenerativeAI.Clients`) works on both platforms, with different inputs:

| | Gemini API | Vertex AI (batch prediction jobs) |
|---|---|---|
| Input | Inline requests (`InlinedRequests`) or an uploaded JSONL file (`FileName`) | Cloud Storage (`GcsUri`) or BigQuery (`BigqueryUri`) |
| Output | Inline responses, or a results file | Cloud Storage prefix or BigQuery table (`BatchJobDestination`) |
| Embedding batches (`CreateEmbeddingsAsync`) | Yes | No (`NotSupportedException`) |
| Per-job `WebhookConfig` | Yes | No (`NotSupportedException`) |
| Cancel | Synchronous request | Accepted immediately, applied asynchronously |

## Prerequisites

- NuGet package: `Google_GenerativeAI`
- Gemini API: an API key. Vertex AI: a project, a region and credentials with access to the GCS bucket or
  BigQuery dataset. See [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication).

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Clients;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

// Gemini API
var googleAi = new GoogleAi(apiKey);
BatchClient batch = googleAi.BatchClient;

// Vertex AI
var vertexAi = new VertexAI(projectId, "us-central1");
BatchClient vertexBatch = vertexAi.BatchClient;
// or: new BatchClient(platformAdapter)
```

## Gemini API: inline requests

```csharp
var source = new BatchJobSource
{
    InlinedRequests = new List<InlinedRequest>
    {
        new InlinedRequest
        {
            Contents = new List<Content> { new Content("Write a haiku about rain.", Roles.User) },
            Metadata = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["key"] = "haiku-1" }
        },
        new InlinedRequest
        {
            Contents = new List<Content> { new Content("Write a haiku about snow.", Roles.User) },
            GenerationConfig = new GenerationConfig { Temperature = 0.2 }
        }
    }
};

BatchJob job = await batch.CreateAsync(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash, source);
Console.WriteLine($"{job.Name} {job.State}");   // e.g. "batches/..." JOB_STATE_PENDING
```

Each `InlinedRequest` can set `Contents`, `SystemInstruction`, `GenerationConfig` (including a response schema),
`SafetySettings`, `Tools`, `ToolConfig`, `CachedContent` and `Metadata`.

## Gemini API: file input

Upload a JSONL file of requests with the Files API (see [Files Client](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Files-Client)) and pass its name:

```csharp
var source = new BatchJobSource { FileName = "files/abc123" };
var job = await batch.CreateAsync(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash, source);
```

## Vertex AI: batch prediction from Cloud Storage or BigQuery

```csharp
// Cloud Storage JSONL in, Cloud Storage out
var job = await vertexBatch.CreateAsync(
    VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini38Flash,
    new BatchJobSource { GcsUri = new List<string> { "gs://my-bucket/input/requests.jsonl" } },
    new BatchJobDestination { GcsUri = "gs://my-bucket/output/" });

// BigQuery in, BigQuery out
var bqJob = await vertexBatch.CreateAsync(
    VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini38Flash,
    new BatchJobSource { BigqueryUri = "bq://my-project.my_dataset.requests" },
    new BatchJobDestination { BigqueryUri = "bq://my-project.my_dataset" });
```

The input format defaults to `jsonl` (GCS) or `bigquery`; set `BatchJobSource.Format` / `BatchJobDestination.Format`
to override it. `FileName` and `InlinedRequests` are not supported on Vertex AI and throw `NotSupportedException`.

## Get a job and wait for it

`GetAsync` returns a `BatchJobResponse`; the job itself is in `Metadata` on both platforms.

```csharp
BatchJob? current;
do
{
    await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
    var response = await batch.GetAsync(job.Name!);
    current = response.Metadata;
    Console.WriteLine(current?.State);
}
while (current?.State is JobState.JOB_STATE_QUEUED or JobState.JOB_STATE_PENDING
       or JobState.JOB_STATE_RUNNING or JobState.JOB_STATE_CANCELLING);
```

Gemini API `BATCH_STATE_*` values are converted to the same `JobState` enum
(`JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED`, `JOB_STATE_FAILED`, `JOB_STATE_CANCELLED`, `JOB_STATE_EXPIRED`, ...).
`BatchJob.BatchStats` has request counts, and `BatchJob.Error` explains a failure.

To avoid polling on the Gemini API, pass a `WebhookConfig` (see below) or register a webhook for
`WebhookEvents.BatchSucceeded` / `BatchFailed` / `BatchExpired`. See [Webhooks](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Webhooks).

## Read the results

**Gemini API, inline requests**: the responses come back in `ContentOutput` (or `EmbeddingOutput` for embedding
batches):

```csharp
var finished = await batch.GetAsync(job.Name!);
var results = finished.ContentOutput?.InlinedResponses?.InlinedResponses;
if (results != null)
{
    foreach (var item in results)
    {
        if (item.Response != null)
            Console.WriteLine(item.Response.Text());
        else
            Console.WriteLine($"Request failed: {item.Error?.Message}");
    }
}
```

For file input, `BatchJob.Destination` holds the result file (`FileName`) or inline responses; download a results
file with the Files API.

**Vertex AI**: results are written to your destination. `BatchJob.OutputInfo` tells you where
(`GcsOutputDirectory`, or `BigqueryOutputDataset` and `BigqueryOutputTable`):

```csharp
var done = (await vertexBatch.GetAsync(job.Name!)).Metadata;
Console.WriteLine(done?.OutputInfo?.GcsOutputDirectory);
```

## List jobs

```csharp
ListBatchJobsResponse page = await batch.ListAsync(pageSize: 20);
foreach (var j in page.BatchJobs ?? new List<BatchJob>())
    Console.WriteLine($"{j.Name} {j.State}");
// Pass page.NextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.
```

## Cancel and delete

```csharp
await batch.CancelAsync(job.Name!);
await batch.DeleteBatchJobAsync(job.Name!);
```

On **Vertex AI, cancellation is asynchronous**: `CancelAsync` returns once the request is accepted, and the job then
moves through `JOB_STATE_CANCELLING` to `JOB_STATE_CANCELLED`. Poll `GetAsync` if you need to confirm it.
A cancelled job cannot be resumed. Deleting a job removes its metadata but not output files that were already written.

## Embedding batches (Gemini API only)

`CreateEmbeddingsAsync(model, source, destination)` creates an asynchronous embedding batch, for example with
`GoogleAIModels.GeminiEmbedding`. Results come back in `BatchJobResponse.EmbeddingOutput`. On Vertex AI it throws
`NotSupportedException`.

## Per-job webhook (Gemini API only)

```csharp
var job = await batch.CreateAsync(
    GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash,
    source,
    destination: null,
    webhookConfig: new WebhookConfig { Uris = new List<string> { "https://example.com/batch-done" } });
```

## Error handling

- API errors are thrown as `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
- `ArgumentException`: empty model or job name, or a source without a valid input for the platform.
- `NotSupportedException`: an input or option the platform doesn't support (see the table above).
- Individual inline requests can fail while the job succeeds: check `InlinedResponse.Error`.

```csharp
try
{
    var job = await batch.CreateAsync(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash, source);
}
catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.ErrorCode == 429)
{
    Console.WriteLine("Batch quota exhausted; try again later.");
}
```

## Related pages

- [Webhooks](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Webhooks)
- [Files Client](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Files-Client)
- [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content)
- [Embeddings](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Embeddings)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Model-Tuning -->

# Model Tuning

Tuning adapts a base model to your data. `TuningClient` (namespace `GenerativeAI.Clients`) mirrors `client.tunings`
of the google-genai SDK and works on both platforms, but they use different resources:

| | Gemini API | Vertex AI |
|---|---|---|
| Resource | `tunedModels` | `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/tuningJobs` |
| Training data | Inline `TuningExample`s (`TextInput` / `Output`) | JSONL in Cloud Storage (`GcsUri`) or a Vertex AI dataset (`VertexDatasetResource`) |
| Methods | Supervised tuning | Supervised fine tuning, preference tuning, distillation, reinforcement tuning (`TuningMethod`) |
| `TuneAsync`, `GetAsync`, `CancelAsync`, `WaitForCompletionAsync` | Yes | Yes |
| `ListAsync` / `ListAllAsync` | No (`NotSupportedException`) | Yes |
| `ValidateRewardAsync` | No (`NotSupportedException`) | Yes |
| Hyperparameters | `EpochCount`, `LearningRateMultiplier`, `BatchSize`, `LearningRate` | All `CreateTuningJobConfig` options |

On the Gemini API, tuned models are reported as `TuningJob` objects so the same code works on both platforms.

## Prerequisites

- NuGet package: `Google_GenerativeAI`
- Gemini API: an API key. Vertex AI: a project, credentials, and a **regional** location (for example
  `us-central1`); tuning is a regional service. See [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication).

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Clients;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

// Vertex AI
var vertexAi = new VertexAI(projectId, "us-central1");
TuningClient tuning = vertexAi.CreateTuningClient();

// Gemini API
var googleAi = new GoogleAi(apiKey);
TuningClient geminiTuning = googleAi.CreateTuningClient();
```

## Create a tuning job on Vertex AI

```csharp
TuningJob job = await tuning.TuneAsync(
    VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini25Flash,
    new TuningDataset { GcsUri = "gs://my-bucket/tuning/train.jsonl" },
    new CreateTuningJobConfig
    {
        TunedModelDisplayName = "support-bot",
        ValidationDataset = new TuningValidationDataset { GcsUri = "gs://my-bucket/tuning/validation.jsonl" },
        EpochCount = 3,
        LearningRateMultiplier = 1.0,
        AdapterSize = AdapterSize.ADAPTER_SIZE_FOUR,
        Labels = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["team"] = "support" }
    });

Console.WriteLine($"{job.Name} {job.State}");
```

Pick a base model that supports tuning in your region (see Google's list of tunable models).

Other `CreateTuningJobConfig` options include `Method` (`TuningMethod.SUPERVISED_FINE_TUNING`,
`PREFERENCE_TUNING`, `DISTILLATION`, `REINFORCEMENT_TUNING`), `Description`, `ExportLastCheckpointOnly`,
`TuningMode`, `BatchSize`, `LearningRate`, `EvaluationConfig`, `OutputUri`, `EncryptionSpec`, `Beta` (preference
tuning), `BaseTeacherModel` / `TunedTeacherModelSource` (distillation), and `RewardConfig` /
`CompositeRewardConfig` / `SamplesPerPrompt` (reinforcement tuning).

To continue tuning from an existing tuned model, pass its resource name (`projects/.../models/...`) as the base model
and set `PreTunedModelCheckpointId`.

## Create a tuned model on the Gemini API

The Gemini API takes inline examples:

```csharp
TuningJob tuned = await geminiTuning.TuneAsync(
    "models/your-tunable-base-model",
    new TuningDataset
    {
        Examples = new List<TuningExample>
        {
            new() { TextInput = "1", Output = "2" },
            new() { TextInput = "3", Output = "4" },
            new() { TextInput = "-3", Output = "-2" }
        }
    },
    new CreateTuningJobConfig
    {
        TunedModelDisplayName = "number generator",
        EpochCount = 5,
        BatchSize = 4,
        LearningRate = 0.001
    });

Console.WriteLine(tuned.Name);   // "tunedModels/..."; State is JOB_STATE_QUEUED
```

Only `Name` and `State` are set in the create response on the Gemini API. Vertex-only options (`GcsUri`,
`VertexDatasetResource`, `ValidationDataset`, `Description`, `AdapterSize`, `Labels`, reward settings and so on)
throw `NotSupportedException`.

## Get, wait, cancel

```csharp
var current = await tuning.GetAsync(job.Name!);
Console.WriteLine(current.State);

// Polls until succeeded, partially succeeded, failed, cancelled or expired.
var finished = await tuning.WaitForCompletionAsync(job.Name!,
    pollInterval: TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),   // default 30 seconds
    timeout: TimeSpan.FromHours(4));         // default: no limit

if (finished.State == JobState.JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED)
{
    Console.WriteLine(finished.TunedModel?.Model);     // Vertex AI: the tuned model resource
    Console.WriteLine(finished.TunedModel?.Endpoint);  // Vertex AI: the endpoint to call
}
else
{
    Console.WriteLine(finished.Error?.Message);
}

await tuning.CancelAsync(job.Name!);
```

On Vertex AI the name can be the full resource name, `tuningJobs/{id}` or just the ID. On the Gemini API it is the
tuned model name (`tunedModels/...`) or its ID.

## List jobs (Vertex AI only)

```csharp
var page = await tuning.ListAsync(pageSize: 10);
foreach (var j in page.TuningJobs ?? new List<TuningJob>())
    Console.WriteLine($"{j.Name} {j.State} {j.BaseModel}");

await foreach (var j in tuning.ListAllAsync(filter: null))
    Console.WriteLine(j.Name);
```

## Validate a reward (Vertex AI only)

`ValidateRewardAsync(sampleResponse, example, singleRewardConfig, compositeRewardConfig, ...)` checks a reward
configuration against a sample response before you start a reinforcement tuning job.

## Error handling

- API errors are thrown as `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
  On Vertex AI, a `FAILED_PRECONDITION` or a message mentioning the region/location usually means the location
  doesn't support tuning (for example `global`); use a regional location.
- `NotSupportedException`: an option or method that the current platform doesn't support.
- `ArgumentException`: empty base model or job name, or an invalid configuration.

```csharp
try
{
    var job = await tuning.TuneAsync(baseModel, dataset, config);
}
catch (NotSupportedException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Not available on this platform: {ex.Message}");
}
catch (ApiException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{ex.ErrorCode} {ex.ErrorStatus}: {ex.ErrorMessage}");
}
```

## Related pages

- [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication)
- [Model Client](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Model-Client)
- [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Webhooks -->

# Webhooks

Webhooks let Google call your HTTPS endpoint when a long-running job finishes, so you don't have to poll. Events
cover batch jobs, interactions and video generation.

The SDK has two pieces:

- `WebhooksClient` (namespace `GenerativeAI.Clients`) registers and manages **project-level** webhooks: create, get,
  list, update, delete, ping and rotate the signing secret.
- **Per-request** webhook configuration: `WebhookConfig` on a batch job and `InteractionWebhookConfig` on an
  interaction.

| Feature | Gemini API | Vertex AI |
|---|---|---|
| `WebhooksClient` | Yes | The client builds the Vertex URL (`.../projects/{project}/locations/{location}/webhooks`); availability depends on the service. |
| `WebhookConfig` on `BatchClient.CreateAsync` | Yes | No: throws `NotSupportedException` |
| `InteractionWebhookConfig` on interactions | Yes | Depends on Interactions API availability |

## Prerequisites

- NuGet package: `Google_GenerativeAI`
- A Gemini API key. See [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication).
- A public HTTPS endpoint that accepts POST requests.

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Clients;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var googleAi = new GoogleAi(apiKey);
WebhooksClient webhooks = googleAi.CreateWebhooksClient();
// or: new WebhooksClient(new GoogleAIPlatformAdapter(apiKey));
```

## Events

Subscribe to events with the constants in `WebhookEvents`:

| Constant | Value |
|---|---|
| `WebhookEvents.BatchSucceeded` | `batch.succeeded` |
| `WebhookEvents.BatchFailed` | `batch.failed` |
| `WebhookEvents.BatchExpired` | `batch.expired` |
| `WebhookEvents.InteractionCompleted` | `interaction.completed` |
| `WebhookEvents.InteractionFailed` | `interaction.failed` |
| `WebhookEvents.InteractionRequiresAction` | `interaction.requires_action` |
| `WebhookEvents.VideoGenerated` | `video.generated` |

## Create a webhook

```csharp
Webhook webhook = await webhooks.CreateAsync(
    "https://example.com/gemini-events",
    new[] { WebhookEvents.BatchSucceeded, WebhookEvents.BatchFailed },
    name: "batch-notifications");

Console.WriteLine(webhook.Id);
// The signing secret is only returned in this response: store it now.
Console.WriteLine(webhook.NewSigningSecret);
```

`CreateAsync(CreateWebhookRequest)` is the long form (`Name`, `Uri`, `SubscribedEvents`). `Uri` and at least one
subscribed event are required; otherwise an `ArgumentException` is thrown.

## Get, list, update and delete

```csharp
var fetched = await webhooks.GetAsync(webhook.Id!);
Console.WriteLine($"{fetched.Uri} {fetched.State}");   // State: WebhookStates.Enabled, Disabled, DisabledDueToFailedDeliveries

// One page at a time (page size defaults to 50, max 1000)...
WebhookListResponse page = await webhooks.ListAsync(pageSize: 50);
// ...or all of them.
await foreach (var w in webhooks.ListAllAsync())
    Console.WriteLine($"{w.Id}: {string.Join(", ", w.SubscribedEvents ?? new List<string>())}");

// Only non-null fields are sent. updateMask is optional (sent as update_mask).
var updated = await webhooks.UpdateAsync(webhook.Id!, new WebhookUpdate
{
    SubscribedEvents = new List<string> { WebhookEvents.InteractionCompleted },
    State = WebhookStates.Enabled
}, updateMask: "subscribed_events,state");

await webhooks.DeleteAsync(webhook.Id!);
```

IDs with a `webhooks/` prefix are accepted.

## Ping

Send a test event to the endpoint:

```csharp
WebhookPingResponse ping = await webhooks.PingAsync(webhook.Id!);
```

## Rotate the signing secret

```csharp
var rotated = await webhooks.RotateSigningSecretAsync(webhook.Id!,
    WebhookRevocationBehaviors.RevokePreviousSecretsAfterH24);   // or RevokePreviousSecretsImmediately
Console.WriteLine(rotated.Secret);
```

`Webhook.SigningSecrets` lists the current secrets (`TruncatedSecret`, `ExpireTime`).

## Per-request webhooks

### Batch jobs (Gemini API only)

Pass a `WebhookConfig` to `BatchClient.CreateAsync`. It is sent as `batch.webhookConfig`:

```csharp
var batch = googleAi.BatchClient;
var job = await batch.CreateAsync(
    GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash,
    source,                       // a BatchJobSource
    destination: null,
    webhookConfig: new WebhookConfig { Uris = new List<string> { "https://example.com/batch-done" } });
```

`WebhookConfig.UserMetadata` (`Dictionary<string, JsonNode?>`) lets you attach your own data to the notification.
On Vertex AI, passing a `WebhookConfig` throws `NotSupportedException`. See [Batch API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Batch-API).

### Interactions

```csharp
var interactions = googleAi.CreateInteractionsClient();
var created = await interactions.CreateAsync(new CreateInteractionRequest
{
    Model = InteractionModels.Gemini38Flash,
    Input = "Write a long report on solar power.",
    Background = true,
    WebhookConfig = new InteractionWebhookConfig { Uris = new List<string> { "https://example.com/interaction-done" } }
});
```

See [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API).

## Verifying signatures

The SDK does **not** include a helper for verifying the signature of incoming webhook requests. Verify deliveries
in your endpoint with the signing secret returned by `CreateAsync` or `RotateSigningSecretAsync`, following
Google's webhook documentation (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/webhooks).

## Error handling

- API errors are thrown as `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
  A 403/404 usually means webhooks are not enabled for the project.
- `ArgumentException` for missing URI, missing events or an empty webhook ID.
- `NotSupportedException` for `WebhookConfig` on a Vertex AI batch job.

```csharp
try
{
    await webhooks.PingAsync(webhookId);
}
catch (ApiException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Ping failed: {ex.ErrorCode} {ex.ErrorStatus} {ex.ErrorMessage}");
}
```

## Related pages

- [Batch API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Batch-API)
- [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Agent-APIs -->

# Agent APIs

These clients cover the agent-related resources of the Gemini API. They follow the matching python-genai clients
(`client.decisions`, `client.voices`, `client.agents`, `client.environments`, `client.triggers`,
`client.credentials`). Agents, environments, triggers and credentials are **experimental** in python-genai and may
change.

| Client | Resource | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `DecisionsClient` | `/decisions` | Calibrated yes/no, choice and score answers about an input |
| `VoicesClient` | `/voices` | Design, remix, replicate and list text-to-speech voices |
| `AgentsClient` | `/agents` | Reusable agent definitions for interactions |
| `EnvironmentsClient` | `/environments` | Sandbox environments for agents, with workspace file upload/download |
| `TriggersClient` | `/triggers` | Run an agent interaction on a cron schedule |
| `CredentialsClient` | `/credentials` | Write-only secrets that agent environments can use |

All of them are in the `GenerativeAI.Clients` namespace; their types are in `GenerativeAI.Types`.

**Availability.** These are Gemini API resources (`{base}/{version}/{collection}`). The clients also build Vertex AI
URLs (`.../projects/{project}/locations/{location}/{collection}`) when given a Vertex adapter, but whether a resource
is enabled there depends on Google's service. A 403/404/`FAILED_PRECONDITION` error usually means the feature is not
enabled for your project.

## Prerequisites

- NuGet package: `Google_GenerativeAI`
- A Gemini API key. See [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication).

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Clients;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var googleAi = new GoogleAi(apiKey);

var decisions    = googleAi.CreateDecisionsClient();
var voices       = googleAi.CreateVoicesClient();
var agents       = googleAi.CreateAgentsClient();
var environments = googleAi.CreateEnvironmentsClient();
var triggers     = googleAi.CreateTriggersClient();
var credentials  = googleAi.CreateCredentialsClient();
// Each client can also be constructed directly, e.g. new DecisionsClient(new GoogleAIPlatformAdapter(apiKey)).
```

## Decisions

The Decisions API evaluates structured questions against a shared input with a decision model
(`DecisionModels.GeminiDecision1`) and returns calibrated probabilities. Question types:

- `NoulDecisionQuestion`: yes/no, with `NoulCriteria` (`TrueDescription`, `FalseDescription`). Answer: `NoulDecisionAnswer` (`Noul`, `Confidence`).
- `ChoiceDecisionQuestion`: pick one of several options (`Criteria`: option → description). Answer: `ChoiceDecisionAnswer` (`Choice`, `Confidence`, `Probabilities`).
- `ScoreDecisionQuestion`: a score against a list of criteria. Answer: `ScoreDecisionAnswer` (`Score`, `Confidence`, `Legend`, `Probabilities`).

```csharp
var response = await decisions.CreateAsync(
    DecisionModels.GeminiDecision1,
    "The sky on a clear day is blue.",
    new Dictionary<string, DecisionQuestion>
    {
        ["sky_color"] = new ChoiceDecisionQuestion
        {
            Instructions = "Which color does the text say the sky is?",
            Criteria = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                ["blue"] = "The text says the sky is blue.",
                ["green"] = "The text says the sky is green."
            }
        },
        ["is_factual"] = new NoulDecisionQuestion
        {
            Instructions = "Is the statement factually correct?",
            Criteria = new NoulCriteria { TrueDescription = "Correct", FalseDescription = "Incorrect" }
        }
    });

if (response.Answers?["sky_color"] is ChoiceDecisionAnswer choice)
    Console.WriteLine($"{choice.Choice} ({choice.Confidence})");
if (response.Answers?["is_factual"] is NoulDecisionAnswer noul)
    Console.WriteLine($"P(true) = {noul.Noul}");
```

The input is an `InteractionInput` (a string converts implicitly). `response.PromptFeedback` explains a blocked
request.

## Voices

Create custom text-to-speech voices and browse the voice catalog.

```csharp
// Voice design: create a voice from a description ("prompted" voice).
Voice designed = await voices.DesignAsync("A calm, warm narrator voice.", displayName: "narrator", store: true);
Console.WriteLine($"{designed.Id} {designed.Key} {designed.Type}");   // Type == VoiceTypes.Prompted

// Remix an existing voice.
Voice remixed = await voices.RemixAsync(designed.Id!, "Make it slightly faster and brighter.", store: true);

// Replicate a voice from recorded audio. A consent recording from the speaker is required.
Voice replicated = await voices.ReplicateAsync(
    VoiceAudioData.FromBytes(await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("speaker.wav"), "audio/wav"),
    VoiceAudioData.FromBytes(await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("consent.wav"), "audio/wav"),
    displayName: "my-voice", store: true);

// List voices (custom and prebuilt), with optional filters.
var page = await voices.ListAsync(new ListVoicesOptions { Type = new List<string> { VoiceTypes.Prebuilt } }, pageSize: 20);
await foreach (var v in voices.ListAllAsync())
    Console.WriteLine($"{v.Id} {v.DisplayName} {v.Gender} {v.LanguageCode}");

var voice = await voices.GetAsync(designed.Id!);
await voices.DeleteAsync(designed.Id!);
```

Designing a voice generates audio samples (`Voice.SampleAudio`), so it is billed. Use a voice's `Key`/`Id` as the
voice of a speech request, for example through `VoiceConfig.Voice` in a speech config.

## Agents

An `Agent` is a reusable definition (base agent, `AgentConfig`, system instruction, tools and base environment)
that interactions can reference.

```csharp
var agent = await agents.CreateAsync(new Agent
{
    Id = "research-helper",
    BaseAgent = InteractionAgents.DeepResearchPreview042026,
    Description = "Researches topics for the support team.",
    SystemInstruction = "Cite your sources."
});

var fetched = await agents.GetAsync("research-helper");
var page = await agents.ListAsync(pageSize: 10);
await foreach (var a in agents.ListAllAsync())
    Console.WriteLine(a.Id);

await agents.DeleteAsync("research-helper");
```

Use agents with the [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API) (`CreateInteractionRequest.Agent`).

## Environments

Environments are sandboxes that agent interactions run in. They can mount sources (GCS bucket, inline files,
repositories, skill registry; see `EnvironmentSourceTypes`) and have workspace files you can list, upload and
download.

```csharp
AgentEnvironment env = await environments.CreateAsync();   // or pass a CreateEnvironmentRequest
Console.WriteLine($"{env.Id} {env.Status}");

// Upload from a stream (or use the overload that takes a local file path).
using (var stream = new MemoryStream(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("hello")))
{
    await environments.UploadFileAsync(env.Id!, "data/hello.txt", stream, "text/plain", overwrite: true);
}

// Upload a tar/tar.gz archive and unpack it into a folder.
await environments.UploadFileAsync(env.Id!, "project", "project.tar.gz", extract: true);

// List and download workspace files.
await foreach (var file in environments.ListAllFilesAsync(env.Id!, recursive: true))
    Console.WriteLine($"{file.Path} {file.Type} {file.SizeBytes}");

byte[] content = await environments.DownloadFileAsync(env.Id!, "data/hello.txt");

await environments.DeleteAsync(env.Id!);
```

Reference an environment from an interaction with `CreateInteractionRequest.Environment`; an
`InteractionEnvironmentReference` converts implicitly from an environment ID string or from an
`InteractionEnvironment` configuration (environment variables, network allowlist, sources).

## Triggers

A trigger runs an interaction on a cron schedule. `Interaction`, `Schedule` and `TimeZone` are required.

```csharp
Trigger trigger = await triggers.CreateAsync(new CreateTriggerRequest
{
    DisplayName = "daily-digest",
    Schedule = "0 8 * * *",
    TimeZone = "Europe/London",
    Interaction = new CreateInteractionRequest
    {
        Agent = InteractionAgents.DeepResearchPreview042026,
        Input = "Summarize yesterday's AI news."
    }
});

await triggers.PauseAsync(trigger.Id!);
await triggers.ResumeAsync(trigger.Id!);
await triggers.UpdateAsync(trigger.Id!, new UpdateTriggerRequest { DisplayName = "morning-digest" });

// Run it now and wait for the execution.
TriggerExecution run = await triggers.RunAsync(trigger.Id!);
var finished = await triggers.WaitForExecutionAsync(trigger.Id!, run.Id!, timeout: TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30));
Console.WriteLine($"{finished.Status} {finished.InteractionId}");   // TriggerExecutionStatuses.*

await foreach (var exec in triggers.ListAllExecutionsAsync(trigger.Id!))
    Console.WriteLine($"{exec.Id} {exec.Status}");

await triggers.DeleteAsync(trigger.Id!);
```

## Credentials

Credentials store secrets that environments can use without exposing them. Secrets are write-only: reads return
metadata (`Id`, `Type`, `Status`) but never the secret.

```csharp
var created = await credentials.CreateAsync(new EnvironmentVariableCredentialConfig
{
    Id = "github-token",
    // System.Environment: GenerativeAI.Types also has an Environment type.
    Value = System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GITHUB_TOKEN"),
    InjectionLocation = new List<string> { CredentialInjectionLocations.Header },
    TrustedDomains = new List<string> { "api.github.com" }
});

// Other types: BearerTokenCredentialConfig (Token, HeaderName, Prefix) and
// OAuth2CredentialConfig (ClientId, ClientSecret, RefreshToken, TokenUrl, Scopes).

var cred = await credentials.GetAsync("github-token");
await foreach (var c in credentials.ListAllAsync())
    Console.WriteLine($"{c.Id} {c.Type} {c.Status}");

await credentials.UpdateAsync("github-token",
    new EnvironmentVariableCredentialConfig { Value = "new-value" }, updateMask: "value");
await credentials.DeleteAsync("github-token");
```

When updating, the credential type must match the stored credential.

## Error handling

- API errors are thrown as `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
  403/404/`FAILED_PRECONDITION` usually means the API is not enabled for the project; 402/429 means billing or
  quota.
- `ArgumentException` for missing required fields (for example a trigger without `Schedule` or `TimeZone`).
- `TriggersClient.WaitForExecutionAsync` throws `TimeoutException` when its timeout is exceeded.

```csharp
try
{
    var env = await environments.CreateAsync();
}
catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.ErrorCode is 403 or 404 || ex.ErrorStatus == "FAILED_PRECONDITION")
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Environments are not available for this project: {ex.ErrorMessage}");
}
```

## Related pages

- [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API)
- [Webhooks](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Webhooks)
- [Multimodal Live API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Live-API)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Image-Generation -->

# Image Generation

Gemini's native image models (the "Nano Banana" family) create and edit images through the normal `generateContent` call: you send text, optionally with images, and the response contains image parts. This works on both the Gemini API and Vertex AI.

The older **Imagen models are retired** on both the Gemini API and Vertex AI (Vertex AI retired them on June 30, 2026). Use the Gemini image models described on this page.

**NuGet packages**

```bash
dotnet add package Google_GenerativeAI             # core SDK
dotnet add package Google_GenerativeAI.Microsoft   # optional: IImageGenerator for Microsoft.Extensions.AI
```

## Models

| Constant (Gemini API: `GoogleAIModels`) | Model ID | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `GeminiNanoBanana21` | `models/gemini-nano-banana-2.1` | Image generation and editing (GA); default for `GenerativeAIImageGenerator` |
| `Gemini3ProImage` | `models/gemini-3-pro-image` | GA |
| `Gemini31FlashImage` | `models/gemini-3.1-flash-image` | GA |
| `Gemini31FlashLiteImage` | `models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` | GA |
| `Gemini25FlashImage` | `models/gemini-2.5-flash-image` | Scheduled for shutdown on March 15, 2027 |

On Vertex AI use `VertexAIModels.Gemini.GeminiNanoBanana21` or `VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini3ProImage`. See [Supported Models](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Supported-Models) for the full list.

## Generating an image

Ask for image output with `ResponseModalities` and read the image from the `InlineData` parts of the response.

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var model = new GenerativeModel(apiKey, GoogleAIModels.GeminiNanoBanana21);

var request = new GenerateContentRequest
{
    GenerationConfig = new GenerationConfig
    {
        ResponseModalities = new List<Modality> { Modality.TEXT, Modality.IMAGE },
        ImageConfig = new ImageConfig
        {
            AspectRatio = ImageConfigValues.AspectRatios.Landscape16x9,
            ImageSize = ImageConfigValues.ImageSizes.Size2K
        }
    }
};
request.AddText("A watercolor painting of a lighthouse at sunrise");

var response = await model.GenerateContentAsync(request);

var index = 0;
foreach (var part in response.Candidates?[0].Content?.Parts ?? new List<Part>())
{
    if (part.InlineData?.Data is { } base64)
        await File.WriteAllBytesAsync($"image_{index++}.png", Convert.FromBase64String(base64));
    else if (part.Text is { } text)
        Console.WriteLine(text);
}
```

`Blob.Data` is base64 encoded; `Blob.MimeType` tells you the format (for example `image/png`).

### `ImageConfig` options

| Property | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `AspectRatio` | `"1:1"`, `"16:9"`, `"9:16"`, `"4:3"`, `"3:4"`, ... | Constants in `ImageConfigValues.AspectRatios` |
| `ImageSize` | `"1K"`, `"2K"`, `"4K"` | Constants in `ImageConfigValues.ImageSizes`; only some models support it |
| `ImageOutputOptions` | `MimeType` (`image/png`, `image/jpeg`), `CompressionQuality` (0-100, JPEG only) | Constants in `ImageConfigValues.OutputMimeTypes`; only some models support it |
| `PersonGeneration` | for example `"ALLOW_ADULT"`, `"DONT_ALLOW"` | Vertex AI only |
| `ProminentPeople` | `ProminentPeople.ALLOW_PROMINENT_PEOPLE`, `BLOCK_PROMINENT_PEOPLE` | Vertex AI only |
| `OutputMimeType`, `OutputCompressionQuality` | MIME type, 0-100 | Vertex AI only |

The `ImageConfigValues` constants are for convenience; any string the API accepts can be used.

You can also set the `GenerationConfig` once on the model (`new GenerativeModel(apiKey, GoogleAIModels.GeminiNanoBanana21, config: ...)`) and then call `model.GenerateContentAsync("prompt")`.

## Editing an image

Send the source image together with the instruction:

```csharp
var request = new GenerateContentRequest
{
    GenerationConfig = new GenerationConfig
    {
        ResponseModalities = new List<Modality> { Modality.TEXT, Modality.IMAGE }
    }
};
request.AddText("Replace the sky with a starry night, keep everything else the same");
request.AddInlineFile("lighthouse.png"); // appended to the same user turn

var response = await model.GenerateContentAsync(request);
```

For large or reused images, upload them first and reference them with `AddRemoteFile` (see [Files Client](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Files-Client) and [Multimodal Features](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Features)). For step-by-step editing across several turns, use a [Chat Session](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Chat-Session) created from the same model.

## Microsoft.Extensions.AI: `GenerativeAIImageGenerator`

`GenerativeAIImageGenerator` (package `Google_GenerativeAI.Microsoft`, namespace `GenerativeAI.Microsoft`) implements MEAI's `IImageGenerator` with the Gemini image models. It requests text and image output and returns the images as `DataContent`.

```csharp
#pragma warning disable MEAI001 // IImageGenerator is experimental in Microsoft.Extensions.AI
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Microsoft;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;

IImageGenerator generator = new GenerativeAIImageGenerator(apiKey); // defaults to GoogleAIModels.GeminiNanoBanana21

var result = await generator.GenerateAsync(
    new ImageGenerationRequest("A cozy reading nook with a cat, digital art"),
    new ImageGenerationOptions { Count = 1 });

foreach (var image in result.Contents.OfType<DataContent>())
    await File.WriteAllBytesAsync("nook.png", image.Data.ToArray());
```

- Constructors: `GenerativeAIImageGenerator(string apiKey, string modelName = GoogleAIModels.GeminiNanoBanana21)` and `GenerativeAIImageGenerator(IPlatformAdapter adapter, string modelName = GoogleAIModels.GeminiNanoBanana21)` (use the adapter overload for Vertex AI).
- Set `ImageGenerationRequest.OriginalImages` to edit existing images.
- `ImageGenerationOptions.Count` sets the candidate count. `ImageSize` is mapped to a media resolution (low, medium or high). `MediaType` is not used, because Gemini can't set the image output format through it.
- For full control, pass a `GenerationConfig` through `ImageGenerationOptions.RawRepresentationFactory`; for example to set `ImageConfig`.
- The raw `GenerateContentResponse` is available in `ImageGenerationResponse.RawRepresentation`, and the underlying `GenerativeModel` in the `model` property.

With `GenerativeAIChatClient` you can also get images from a chat by setting `AdditionalPropertiesKeys.ResponseModalities` and the `ImageConfig*` keys in `ChatOptions.AdditionalProperties` (see [Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Microsoft.Extensions.AI-IChatClient-Implementation#gemini-specific-options)).

## Imagen (retired)

Google has retired every Imagen model: on the Gemini API, and on Vertex AI on June 30, 2026, where Google names
`gemini-2.5-flash-image` as the replacement. The SDK's Imagen APIs are therefore marked `[Obsolete]` and produce
warning `CS0618`:

| Obsolete API | Use instead |
|---|---|
| `ImagenModel`, `GenAI.CreateImageModel(...)` | `CreateGenerativeModel` with a Gemini image model and the `IMAGE` response modality (see above) |
| `GenerativeAIImagenGenerator` (Microsoft.Extensions.AI) | `GenerativeAIImageGenerator` |
| `GoogleAIModels.Imagen.*`, `VertexAIModels.Imagen.*` | `GoogleAIModels.GeminiNanoBanana21`, `Gemini3ProImage` or `Gemini31FlashImage`, and the matching `VertexAIModels.Gemini` constants |

Requests to Imagen models fail with an `ApiException` (HTTP 404), so migrate any remaining Imagen code to the Gemini
image models.

### Legacy: image captioning and visual question answering

`ImageTextModel` (created with `vertexAi.CreateImageTextModel()`) calls Vertex AI's legacy `imagetext` model for captions (`GenerateImageCaptionFromLocalFileAsync`, `GenerateImageCaptionFromGcsImageAsync`) and visual Q&A (`VisualQuestionAnsweringFromLocalFileAsync`, `VisualQuestionAnsweringFromGcsFileAsync`). For new code, send the image to a Gemini model instead (see [Multimodal Features](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Features)).

## Related pages

- [Video Generation](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Video-Generation)
- [Multimodal Features](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Features)
- [Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Microsoft.Extensions.AI-IChatClient-Implementation)
- [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Video-Generation -->

# Video Generation

`VideoGenerationModel` generates videos with Google's **Veo** models on **Vertex AI**. Generation is a long-running operation: you start it, then poll until the video is ready.

> **Veo on the Gemini API is retired.** On the Gemini API, `VideoGenerationModel.GenerateVideosAsync` throws `NotSupportedException` straight away instead of sending a request the API would reject. To generate video on the Gemini API, use a Gemini Omni model (`GoogleAIModels.Video.GeminiOmni12Flash`, or `InteractionModels.GeminiOmni12Flash` in the Interactions API) through the [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API).

**NuGet packages**

```bash
dotnet add package Google_GenerativeAI
dotnet add package Google_GenerativeAI.Auth   # service account / OAuth authenticators for Vertex AI
```

Video generation is billed per second of output and can be expensive; start with short durations and one video.

## Models (Vertex AI)

| Constant (`VertexAIModels.Video`) | Model ID |
|---|---|
| `Veo31GeneratePreview` | `veo-3.1-generate-preview` |
| `Veo31FastGeneratePreview` | `veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` |
| `Veo3Generate001` | `veo-3.0-generate-001` |
| `Veo3FastGenerate001` | `veo-3.0-fast-generate-001` |
| `Veo3GeneratePreview` | `veo-3.0-generate-preview` |
| `Veo3FastGeneratePreview` | `veo-3.0-fast-generate-preview` |
| `Veo2Generate001` | `veo-2.0-generate-001` (default for `CreateVideoGenerationModel()`) |

The `GoogleAIModels.Video.Veo*` constants are marked `[Obsolete]` because those models are shut down on the Gemini API. Check the Vertex AI documentation for which Veo versions are currently available in your region.

## Generating a video

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Authenticators;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var vertexAi = new VertexAI(
    projectId: "your-project-id",
    region: "us-central1",
    authenticator: new GoogleServiceAccountAuthenticator("service-account.json"));

var videoModel = vertexAi.CreateVideoGenerationModel(VertexAIModels.Video.Veo3FastGenerate001);

var operation = await videoModel.GenerateVideosAsync(
    "A dog catching a ball in a sunny park",
    config: new GenerateVideosConfig
    {
        AspectRatio = VideoAspectRatio.LANDSCAPE_16_9,
        DurationSeconds = 5,
        NumberOfVideos = 1,
        Resolution = VideoResolution.HD_720P,
        PersonGeneration = VideoPersonGeneration.AllowAdult,
        EnhancePrompt = true
    });

var result = await videoModel.AwaitForLongRunningOperation(operation!.Name!);

if (result?.Done == true && result.Result?.GeneratedVideos is { Count: > 0 } videos)
{
    var video = videos[0];
    if (video.VideoBytes != null)
        await File.WriteAllBytesAsync("dog.mp4", video.VideoBytes);
    else
        Console.WriteLine($"Video stored at {video.Uri}"); // when OutputGcsUri is set
}
```

You can also construct the model directly: `new VideoGenerationModel(platformAdapter, VertexAIModels.Video.Veo3FastGenerate001)`, where `platformAdapter` must be a `VertextPlatformAdapter`.

### API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `GenerateVideosAsync(GenerateVideosRequest request, CancellationToken)` | Starts generation (`predictLongRunning`). Returns a `GenerateVideosOperation`. |
| `GenerateVideosAsync(string prompt, ImageSample? referenceImage = null, GenerateVideosConfig? config = null, CancellationToken)` | Same, from a prompt and optional starting image. |
| `AwaitForLongRunningOperation(string operationId, int? timeOut = null, CancellationToken)` | Polls every second until the operation is done (for up to 10 minutes). Throws `VertexAIException` if the operation finished with an error. |
| `GetVideoGenerationStatusAsync(string operationId, int? timeOut = null, CancellationToken)` | Checks the operation once. Use it to poll on your own schedule. |
| `ModelName` | The model in use. |

`GenerateVideosOperation` has `Name`, `Done`, `Error` and, when done, `Result` (`GenerateVideosResponse`):

- `GeneratedVideos`: a `List<Video>`; each `Video` has `VideoBytes` (also exposed as `BytesBase64Encoded`), `Uri` and `MimeType`.
- `RaiMediaFilteredCount` and `RaiMediaFilteredReasons`: videos removed by safety filters.

## Image-to-video

Pass a starting frame as an `ImageSample` (bytes or a Cloud Storage URI):

```csharp
var firstFrame = new ImageSample
{
    ImageBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("first-frame.png"),
    MimeType = "image/png"
    // or: GcsUri = "gs://bucket/first-frame.png"
};

var operation = await videoModel.GenerateVideosAsync(
    "The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the whole city",
    referenceImage: firstFrame,
    config: new GenerateVideosConfig { DurationSeconds = 5 });
```

## `GenerateVideosConfig`

These settings are sent to Vertex AI by `VideoGenerationModel`:

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NumberOfVideos` | `int?` | Number of videos to generate |
| `DurationSeconds` | `int?` | Length of each video |
| `AspectRatio` | `VideoAspectRatio?` | `LANDSCAPE_16_9` or `PORTRAIT_9_16` |
| `Resolution` | `VideoResolution?` | `HD_720P` or `FullHD_1080P` |
| `Fps` | `int?` | Frames per second |
| `Seed` | `int?` | Seed for more repeatable results |
| `NegativePrompt` | `string?` | What to avoid |
| `EnhancePrompt` | `bool?` | Let the service rewrite the prompt |
| `PersonGeneration` | `VideoPersonGeneration?` | `DontAllow` or `AllowAdult` |
| `OutputGcsUri` | `string?` | Cloud Storage location for the output (then `Video.Uri` is set instead of bytes) |
| `PubsubTopic` | `string?` | Pub/Sub topic for completion notifications |

`GenerateVideosConfig` also defines `GenerateAudio`, `LastFrame`, `ReferenceImages` (`VideoGenerationReferenceImage` with `VideoGenerationReferenceType.STYLE`/`ASSET`), `Mask` (`VideoGenerationMask` with `VideoGenerationMaskMode`) and `CompressionQuality` (`VideoCompressionQuality.OPTIMIZED`/`LOSSLESS`). `VideoGenerationModel` does **not** currently forward these to the Vertex AI request.

## Related pages

- [Image Generation](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Image-Generation)
- [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API) (Gemini Omni video on the Gemini API)
- [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication)
- [Supported Models](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Supported-Models)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Speech-Generation -->

# Speech Generation (Text-to-Speech)

Gemini's text-to-speech (TTS) models turn text into spoken audio through the normal `generateContent` call. You ask for audio output with `ResponseModalities`, choose a voice with `SpeechConfig`, and read the audio from the response's inline data. Both single-speaker and multi-speaker (dialogue) output are supported.

For real-time, two-way voice conversations use the [Multimodal Live API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Live-API) instead.

**NuGet package**

```bash
dotnet add package Google_GenerativeAI
```

## Models

| Constant (`GoogleAIModels`) | Model ID | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Gemini38FlashTts` | `models/gemini-3.8-flash-tts` | GA |
| `Gemini38FlashLiteTts` | `models/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts` | GA |
| `Gemini31FlashTtsPreview` | `models/gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview` | Scheduled for shutdown on December 18, 2026 |
| `Gemini25FlashPreviewTts`, `Gemini25ProPreviewTts` | | `[Obsolete]`, scheduled for shutdown on December 18, 2026 |

On Vertex AI use `VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini38FlashTts`.

## Single speaker

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var model = new GenerativeModel(apiKey, GoogleAIModels.Gemini38FlashTts);

var request = new GenerateContentRequest
{
    GenerationConfig = new GenerationConfig
    {
        ResponseModalities = new List<Modality> { Modality.AUDIO },
        SpeechConfig = new SpeechConfig
        {
            VoiceConfig = new VoiceConfig
            {
                PrebuiltVoiceConfig = new PrebuiltVoiceConfig { VoiceName = "Kore" }
            },
            LanguageCode = "en-US" // optional, BCP 47
        }
    }
};
request.AddText("Say cheerfully: Have a wonderful day!");

var response = await model.GenerateContentAsync(request);

var audio = response.Candidates?[0].Content?.Parts.FirstOrDefault(p => p.InlineData != null)?.InlineData;
if (audio?.Data != null)
{
    byte[] pcm = Convert.FromBase64String(audio.Data);
    Console.WriteLine($"Received {pcm.Length} bytes of {audio.MimeType}");
}
```

Style instructions in the prompt ("Say cheerfully", "Whisper", "Read slowly") control tone and pace.

## Multi-speaker dialogue

Use `MultiSpeakerVoiceConfig` instead of `VoiceConfig` (they are mutually exclusive). Each `Speaker` name must match the speaker labels in your text.

```csharp
var config = new GenerationConfig
{
    ResponseModalities = new List<Modality> { Modality.AUDIO },
    SpeechConfig = new SpeechConfig
    {
        MultiSpeakerVoiceConfig = new MultiSpeakerVoiceConfig
        {
            SpeakerVoiceConfigs = new List<SpeakerVoiceConfig>
            {
                new() { Speaker = "Joe",  VoiceConfig = new VoiceConfig { PrebuiltVoiceConfig = new PrebuiltVoiceConfig { VoiceName = "Kore" } } },
                new() { Speaker = "Jane", VoiceConfig = new VoiceConfig { PrebuiltVoiceConfig = new PrebuiltVoiceConfig { VoiceName = "Puck" } } }
            }
        }
    }
};

var model = new GenerativeModel(apiKey, GoogleAIModels.Gemini38FlashTts, config: config);

var response = await model.GenerateContentAsync(
    "TTS the following conversation between Joe and Jane:\nJoe: How's it going today, Jane?\nJane: Not too bad, how about you?");
```

## Saving the audio

Gemini TTS returns raw 16-bit PCM audio (mono, 24 kHz); check `InlineData.MimeType` for the exact format. Add a WAV header to play it in ordinary players. The `Google_GenerativeAI.Live` package includes a helper:

```csharp
using GenerativeAI.Live.Helper; // Google_GenerativeAI.Live package

byte[] wav = AudioHelper.AddWaveHeader(pcm, numberOfChannels: 1, sampleRate: 24000, bitsPerSample2: 16);
await File.WriteAllBytesAsync("speech.wav", wav);
```

## Voice options

`VoiceConfig` selects one voice in one of three ways:

| Property | Use |
|---|---|
| `PrebuiltVoiceConfig.VoiceName` | A prebuilt voice, for example `"Kore"` or `"Puck"` (see the [Gemini TTS voice list](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation#voices)) |
| `Voice` | The name of a custom voice resource, for example one designed or replicated with `VoicesClient` (see [Agent APIs](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Agent-APIs#voices)) |
| `ReplicatedVoiceConfig` | Speak with a voice replicated from an audio sample (`MimeType`, `VoiceSampleAudio`, `ConsentAudio`) |

`SpeechConfig.LanguageCode` sets the output language (BCP 47, for example `"en-US"`).

## Related pages

- [Multimodal Live API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Live-API)
- [Agent APIs](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Agent-APIs) (custom voices)
- [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content)
- [Supported Models](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Supported-Models)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Files-Client -->

`FileClient` works with the Gemini API Files service. It can upload files (from a path or a stream), register Google Cloud Storage objects, read metadata, list, delete, download generated files (such as videos) and wait for a file to finish processing. Uploaded files can then be referenced in prompts.

Package: `Google_GenerativeAI`. Namespace: `GenerativeAI.Clients`.

> The Files API is a **Gemini Developer API** feature. On Vertex AI, reference files in Cloud Storage (`gs://...`) or send them inline instead (see [Multimodal Features](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Features)). `DownloadFileAsync` and `RegisterFilesAsync` throw `NotSupportedException` on Vertex AI.

## Getting a `FileClient`

### From `GeminiModel.Files`

`GeminiModel` (created with `GoogleAi.CreateGeminiModel`) comes with a `FileClient` in its `Files` property, so you don't need to create one:

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Clients;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var geminiModel = new GoogleAi("YOUR_API_KEY").CreateGeminiModel(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash);

var remoteFile = await geminiModel.Files!.UploadFileAsync(
    "path/to/my/file.txt",
    progressCallback: progress => Console.WriteLine($"Upload Progress: {progress:F2}%"));

Console.WriteLine($"File uploaded successfully. Remote File Name: {remoteFile.Name}");
```

`GeminiModel` also has shortcuts: `UploadFileAsync(filePath, progressCallback)`, `GetFileAsync(fileId)` and `AwaitForFileStateActive(file, maxSeconds)`.

### Standalone

```csharp
var fileClient = new FileClient(new GoogleAIPlatformAdapter("YOUR_API_KEY"));
```

## 1. Uploading Files

### From a file path (`UploadFileAsync`)

The display name is the file name without its extension, and the MIME type is detected from the extension.

```csharp
try
{
    RemoteFile remoteFile = await fileClient.UploadFileAsync(
        "path/to/my/video.mp4",
        progressCallback: progress => Console.WriteLine($"Upload Progress: {progress:F2}%"));

    Console.WriteLine($"Uploaded: {remoteFile.Name} ({remoteFile.Uri})");
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Error uploading file: {ex.Message}");
}
```

### From a stream (`UploadStreamAsync`)

```csharp
using var fileStream = File.OpenRead("path/to/my/file.txt");

RemoteFile remoteFile = await fileClient.UploadStreamAsync(
    fileStream,
    displayName: "my_uploaded_file",
    mimeType: "text/plain",
    progressCallback: progress => Console.WriteLine($"Upload Progress: {progress:F2}%"));
```

The stream must report its `Length`, and the MIME type must be in `FilesConstants.SupportedMimeTypes`.

## 2. Registering Cloud Storage Files (`RegisterFilesAsync`)

Registers existing `gs://` objects with the Files service, so you can use them in prompts without uploading them again. The SDK needs an OAuth access token with read access to the objects. If you don't pass `accessToken`, it uses the platform's token, authenticator or Application Default Credentials.

```csharp
RegisterFilesResponse registered = await fileClient.RegisterFilesAsync(
    new[] { "gs://my-bucket/report.pdf", "gs://my-bucket/chart.png" },
    accessToken: null,                // optional OAuth token
    quotaProjectId: "my-gcp-project"); // optional, sent as x-goog-user-project

foreach (var file in registered.Files ?? new List<RemoteFile>())
    Console.WriteLine($"{file.Name} -> {file.Uri} (source: {file.Source})");
```

Registered files have `Source == Source.REGISTERED`.

## 3. Getting File Metadata (`GetFileAsync`)

```csharp
RemoteFile remoteFile = await fileClient.GetFileAsync("files/your-file-id");
Console.WriteLine($"File Name: {remoteFile.Name}, Size: {remoteFile.SizeBytes}, State: {remoteFile.State}");
```

`RemoteFile` properties include `Name`, `DisplayName`, `MimeType`, `SizeBytes`, `CreateTime`, `UpdateTime`, `ExpirationTime`, `Sha256Hash`, `Uri`, `DownloadUri`, `State` (`PROCESSING`, `ACTIVE`, `FAILED`), `Source` (`UPLOADED`, `GENERATED`, `REGISTERED`), `Error` and `VideoMetadata`.

## 4. Listing Files (`ListFilesAsync`)

```csharp
var response = await fileClient.ListFilesAsync(pageSize: 20); // max 100

foreach (var file in response.Files ?? new List<RemoteFile>())
    Console.WriteLine($"File Name: {file.Name}, Display Name: {file.DisplayName}");

if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(response.NextPageToken))
{
    var next = await fileClient.ListFilesAsync(pageSize: 20, pageToken: response.NextPageToken);
}
```

## 5. Deleting Files (`DeleteFileAsync`)

```csharp
await fileClient.DeleteFileAsync("files/your-file-id");
```

## 6. Downloading Generated Files (`DownloadFileAsync`, `DownloadFileToPathAsync`)

Files the API **generated**, for example videos from Veo, can be downloaded. Files you uploaded can't. Check `RemoteFile.DownloadUri` or `RemoteFile.Source == Source.GENERATED` first.

```csharp
// Into memory
byte[] bytes = await fileClient.DownloadFileAsync("files/generated-file-id");

// From a RemoteFile (throws ArgumentException if it has no DownloadUri)
byte[] bytes2 = await fileClient.DownloadFileAsync(remoteFile);

// Stream to any writable stream without buffering the whole file
await using (var output = File.Create("video.mp4"))
{
    await fileClient.DownloadFileAsync(remoteFile, output);
}

// Straight to a local path
await fileClient.DownloadFileToPathAsync("files/generated-file-id", "video.mp4");
```

The `name` can be `files/{id}`, `{id}`, or the file's download or URI URL.

## 7. Waiting for a File to Become Active (`AwaitForFileStateActiveAsync`)

Video and other large files are processed after upload. Wait for the file to become `ACTIVE` before you use it in a prompt:

```csharp
var remoteFile = await fileClient.UploadFileAsync("lecture.mp4");
await fileClient.AwaitForFileStateActiveAsync(remoteFile, maxSeconds: 300, cancellationToken: CancellationToken.None);
Console.WriteLine("File is now active.");
```

If processing fails, it throws `GenerativeAIException`.

## Using a File in a Prompt

```csharp
var request = new GenerateContentRequest();
request.AddRemoteFile(remoteFile);
request.AddText("Summarize this video.");

var response = await geminiModel.GenerateContentAsync(request);
Console.WriteLine(response.Text());

// Or pass the file URI and MIME type directly
var response2 = await geminiModel.GenerateContentAsync("Summarize this video.", remoteFile.Uri!, remoteFile.MimeType!);
```

## Important Considerations

- **File size limits**: Uploads are limited to `FilesConstants.MaxUploadFileSize` (2 GB). Larger files throw `FileTooLargeException`. Missing files throw `FileNotFoundException`.
- **MIME types**: Unsupported MIME types throw `NotSupportedException`. Set the correct type when you upload from a stream.
- **Errors**: API failures throw `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
- **Authentication**: `FileClient` uses the credentials of its platform adapter. `RegisterFilesAsync` also needs an OAuth token. See [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication).
- **Cancellation**: Every method accepts a `CancellationToken`.

- [UploadStreamAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=UploadStreamAsync)
- [RegisterFilesAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=RegisterFilesAsync)
- [GetFileAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=GetFileAsync)
- [ListFilesAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=ListFilesAsync)
- [DeleteFileAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=DeleteFileAsync)
- [DownloadFileAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=DownloadFileAsync)
- [AwaitForFileStateActiveAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=AwaitForFileStateActiveAsync)

- [ListFilesResponse](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=ListFilesResponse)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Model-Client -->

`ModelClient` reads model metadata from the Models API. It can list models, get one model's details (token limits, supported methods, thinking support), update or delete tuned models, and tokenize content on Vertex AI.

Package: `Google_GenerativeAI`. Namespace: `GenerativeAI.Clients`.

## Getting a `ModelClient`

`GoogleAi` and `VertexAI` (through their `GenAI` base class) expose a ready-made `ModelClient` property and the `ListModelsAsync` / `GetModelAsync` shortcuts. You can also create the client from a platform adapter:

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Clients;
using GenerativeAI.Types;

var googleAI = new GoogleAi("YOUR_API_KEY");
ModelClient modelClient = googleAI.ModelClient;

// Or standalone
var modelClient2 = new ModelClient(new GoogleAIPlatformAdapter("YOUR_API_KEY"));
var vertexModelClient = new ModelClient(new VertextPlatformAdapter("your-project-id", "global"));
```

## 1. Getting Model Information (`GetModelAsync`)

```csharp
Model model = await modelClient.GetModelAsync(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash); // "models/gemini-3.8-flash"

Console.WriteLine($"Name: {model.Name}, Version: {model.Version}");
Console.WriteLine($"Input limit: {model.InputTokenLimit}, Output limit: {model.OutputTokenLimit}");
Console.WriteLine($"Methods: {string.Join(", ", model.SupportedGenerationMethods ?? new())}");
Console.WriteLine($"Thinking: {model.Thinking}");

// Shortcut on GoogleAi / VertexAI
var sameModel = await googleAI.GetModelAsync(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash);
```

You can pass the model name with or without the `models/` prefix.

## 2. Listing Models (`ListModelsAsync`)

```csharp
ListModelsResponse response = await modelClient.ListModelsAsync(pageSize: 20);

foreach (var m in response.Models ?? new List<Model>())
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{m.Name} - {m.DisplayName}");
}

// Next page
if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(response.NextPageToken))
{
    var next = await modelClient.ListModelsAsync(pageSize: 20, pageToken: response.NextPageToken);
}

// Shortcut on GoogleAi / VertexAI
var models = await googleAI.ListModelsAsync(pageSize: 20);
```

## 3. Updating a Tuned Model (`UpdateModelAsync`)

Updates the display name, description or default checkpoint of a tuned model. Only the fields you set are sent.

```csharp
Model updated = await modelClient.UpdateModelAsync("tunedModels/my-tuned-model", new UpdateModelConfig
{
    DisplayName = "Support bot v2",
    Description = "Tuned on Q3 support tickets"
});
```

Model names are `tunedModels/{id}` on the Gemini API, and `models/{id}` or `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/models/{id}` on Vertex AI.

## 4. Deleting a Tuned Model (`DeleteModelAsync`)

```csharp
await modelClient.DeleteModelAsync("tunedModels/my-tuned-model");
```

## 5. Tokenizing Content (`ComputeTokensAsync`, Vertex AI only)

Returns the tokens and token IDs for each content. On the Gemini API it throws `NotSupportedException`. To count tokens on either platform, use `GenerativeModel.CountTokensAsync` (see [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content#counting-tokens)).

```csharp
var vertex = new VertexAI("your-project-id", "global");
ComputeTokensResponse tokens = await vertex.ModelClient.ComputeTokensAsync(
    VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini38Flash,
    new[] { new Content("Hello world", Roles.User) });

foreach (var info in tokens.TokensInfo ?? new List<TokensInfo>())
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{info.Role}: {string.Join(",", info.TokenIds ?? new List<long>())}");
}
```

## Important Considerations

1. **Model names**: On the Gemini API, model resource names look like `models/gemini-3.8-flash`. Use the constants in `GoogleAIModels` and `VertexAIModels.Gemini`.
2. **Pagination**: Use `pageSize` and `pageToken` to page through long lists.
3. **Errors**: Failed calls throw `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
4. **Authentication**: `ModelClient` uses the credentials of its platform adapter. See [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication).

## Related Pages

- [Initialization](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Initialization)
- [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content)

## API Reference

- [ModelClient](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=ModelClient)
- [GetModelAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=GetModelAsync)
- [ListModelsAsync](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=ListModelsAsync)
- [Model](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=Model)
- [ListModelsResponse](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=ListModelsResponse)
- [UpdateModelConfig](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=UpdateModelConfig)
- [ComputeTokensResponse](https://gunpal5.github.io/generative-ai/search.html?SearchText=ComputeTokensResponse)

<!-- Source: https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Vertex-RAG-Engine -->

# Vertex RAG Engine

The Vertex AI RAG Engine lets you build knowledge bases (**corpora**), import your documents into them, and ground
Gemini responses on that data (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). In the SDK, `VertexRagManager` manages the RAG
Engine configuration, corpora and files, and the retrieval tool connects a corpus to a `GenerativeModel`.

| Platform | Support |
|---|---|
| Vertex AI | Yes, in **regional** locations only (for example `us-central1`). |
| Gemini API | No. Use [File Search](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/File-Search) instead. `UseVertexRetrievalTool` throws `NotSupportedException` outside Vertex AI. |

## Prerequisites

- NuGet packages: `Google_GenerativeAI`, plus `Google_GenerativeAI.Auth` for `GoogleServiceAccountAuthenticator`
- A Google Cloud project with the Vertex AI API enabled.
- **Serverless mode** (the mode for new projects, see below) also needs the **Vector Search API
  (`vectorsearch.googleapis.com`)** enabled.
- Credentials with enough IAM permissions, for example `Vertex AI User` and `Vertex AI RAG Data Service Agent`
  (plus `Secret Manager Secret Accessor` if you use Pinecone/Weaviate API keys stored in Secret Manager).
- **A regional location.** The RAG Engine is **not available in the `global` location**. Use a region such as
  `us-central1`, with a model that is served in that region.

```csharp
using GenerativeAI;
using GenerativeAI.Authenticators;
using GenerativeAI.Types.RagEngine;   // VertexRagManager and the RAG types

var vertexAi = new VertexAI(projectId, "us-central1",
    authenticator: new GoogleServiceAccountAuthenticator("path/to/service-account.json"));
// or another authenticator, e.g. ADC. See the Authentication page.

VertexRagManager ragManager = vertexAi.CreateRagManager();
```

## RAG Engine configuration: Serverless vs Spanner

The RAG Engine stores its data in a RAG-managed database, configured per project and location:

- **Serverless mode** (`RagManagedDbConfig.CreateServerless()`): no provisioned database, billed per use.
  **New projects must use Serverless mode.** It requires the Vector Search API (`vectorsearch.googleapis.com`).
- **Spanner mode**: a provisioned Spanner database, with the Scaled tier
  (`RagManagedDbConfig.CreateSpannerScaled()`) or the Basic tier (`RagManagedDbConfig.CreateSpannerBasic()`).

Read, change or switch the configuration on `VertexRagManager`:

```csharp
// Current mode
RagEngineConfig? current = await ragManager.GetEngineConfigAsync();
bool isServerless = current?.RagManagedDbConfig?.Serverless != null;
Console.WriteLine(isServerless ? "Serverless" : "Spanner");

// Switch to Serverless (waits for the change to complete)
await ragManager.SwitchToServerlessModeAsync();

// Or set any configuration explicitly
await ragManager.UpdateEngineConfigAsync(new RagEngineConfig
{
    RagManagedDbConfig = RagManagedDbConfig.CreateSpannerBasic()
});
```

**Warning:** setting `RagManagedDbSpanner.Unprovisioned` disables the RAG Engine and **permanently deletes all of its
data**.

## Corpora

A corpus is a knowledge base. `CreateCorpusAsync` waits for the create operation and returns the `RagCorpus`.

```csharp
// RAG-managed vector store (the default)
RagCorpus? corpus = await ragManager.CreateCorpusAsync("product-docs", "Manuals and FAQs");
Console.WriteLine(corpus?.Name);   // projects/.../locations/us-central1/ragCorpora/...
```

Other overloads use an external vector database: Pinecone (`RagVectorDbConfigPinecone`), Weaviate
(`RagVectorDbConfigWeaviate`), Vertex AI Feature Store or Vertex AI Vector Search. Pinecone and Weaviate take the
Secret Manager resource name of the database API key
(`projects/{PROJECT_NUMBER}/secrets/{SECRET_ID}/versions/{VERSION_ID}`). Every overload takes an optional
`embeddingModelName`.

```csharp
var list = await ragManager.ListCorporaAsync(pageSize: 10);
foreach (var c in list?.RagCorpora ?? new List<RagCorpus>())
    Console.WriteLine($"{c.Name} {c.DisplayName} {c.RagFilesCount}");

var one = await ragManager.GetCorpusAsync(corpus!.Name!);
var updated = await ragManager.UpdateCorpusAsync(one!);
await ragManager.DeleteRagCorpusAsync(corpus.Name!);
```

**Newly created corpora can take a while to appear in list results**, especially in Serverless mode. If you list
right after creating, retry for a short time, or keep the name returned by `CreateCorpusAsync`.

## Upload and import files

Upload a local file:

```csharp
RagFile? file = await ragManager.UploadLocalFileAsync(
    corpus.Name!, "docs/manual.pdf",
    displayName: "Manual",
    description: "Router X user manual",
    progressCallback: p => Console.WriteLine($"{p:F0}%"));
```

A brand-new corpus can briefly reject uploads; retry after a few seconds if that happens.

Import files from Cloud Storage, Google Drive, Slack, Jira or SharePoint. Imports are long-running operations;
wait for them with `AwaitForLongRunningOperation`:

```csharp
var operation = await ragManager.ImportFilesAsync(corpus.Name!, new GcsSource
{
    Uris = new List<string> { "gs://my-bucket/docs/" }
});

if (operation?.Name != null)
    await ragManager.AwaitForLongRunningOperation(operation.Name);   // default timeout: LongRunningOperationTimeout (5 min)
```

Each `ImportFilesAsync` overload takes optional `RagFileParsingConfig` and `RagFileTransformationConfig` arguments.
For full control, pass an `ImportRagFilesRequest`.

Manage files:

```csharp
var files = await ragManager.ListFilesAsync(corpus.Name!);
foreach (var f in files?.RagFiles ?? new List<RagFile>())
    Console.WriteLine($"{f.Name} {f.DisplayName}");

var ragFile = await ragManager.GetFileAsync(fileName);
await ragManager.DeleteFileAsync(fileName);
```

## Ground generation on a corpus

Pass the corpus name as `corpusIdForRag` when you create the model. It adds a Vertex retrieval tool for that corpus:

```csharp
var model = vertexAi.CreateGenerativeModel(
    VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini25Flash,     // a model served in your region
    corpusIdForRag: corpus.Name);

var result = await model.GenerateContentAsync("What does the manual say about factory resets?");
Console.WriteLine(result.Text());
```

Tune retrieval with `ragRetrievalConfig`:

```csharp
var model = vertexAi.CreateGenerativeModel(
    VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini25Flash,
    corpusIdForRag: corpus.Name,
    ragRetrievalConfig: new RagRetrievalConfig
    {
        Filter = new RagRetrievalConfigFilter { VectorDistanceThreshold = 0.5 },
        HybridSearch = new RagRetrievalConfigHybridSearch { Alpha = 0.5f }
    });
```

You can also add the tool to an existing model with `model.UseVertexRetrievalTool(corpusName, retrievalConfig)`.

## Error handling

- API errors are thrown as `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException` (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
  - A region/location error or `FAILED_PRECONDITION` usually means you are using `global`, or the RAG Engine is not
    available in that region. Use a regional location such as `us-central1`.
  - In Serverless mode, a permission or "API not enabled" error can mean the Vector Search API is not enabled.
- A failed long-running operation (create corpus, engine config change, `AwaitForLongRunningOperation`) throws
  `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.VertexAIException` with the operation's error.
- `NotSupportedException` from `UseVertexRetrievalTool` when the model is not on Vertex AI.

```csharp
try
{
    var corpus = await ragManager.CreateCorpusAsync("docs", null);
}
catch (ApiException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{ex.ErrorCode} {ex.ErrorStatus}: {ex.ErrorMessage}");
}
catch (VertexAIException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Operation failed: {ex.Message}");
}
```

## Important considerations

- **Cost:** imports, embeddings and queries are billed; Spanner mode also bills for provisioned capacity.
- **Latency:** larger corpora and external vector databases can add latency.
- **Keep data fresh:** re-import changed documents to keep answers accurate.

Official documentation: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/rag-overview and
https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/rag-engine/switching-modes

## Related pages

- [File Search](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/File-Search): managed RAG on the Gemini API
- [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication)
- [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content)
